question: What does RayJai teach about the Manifestor aura and why it repels people?
cypher_query:
MATCH (r:RayJaiTeaching)
WHERE (r.related_hd_concept CONTAINS "Manifestor" OR r.insight CONTAINS "Manifestor" OR r.context CONTAINS "Manifestor")
AND (r.insight CONTAINS "repel" OR r.context CONTAINS "repel" OR r.insight CONTAINS "aura" OR r.context CONTAINS "aura")
RETURN r.name, r.insight, r.context, r.related_hd_concept
LIMIT 20

teachings.name: Manifestor Aura Protection
teachings.insight: The aura for manifestors protects us because we have constantly, always been tried or always been put under some sort of pressure or some sort of control by other people because they can't read us. It's very challenging to read a manifestor aura only because not, not because that we're blocking. But our aura is so thick, it's so dense because it's trying to protect us that nobody can kind of see what's going on in our heads.

teachings.name: Manifestor Book Metaphor
teachings.insight: I'm not an open book. My book is closed, but I'm happy for people to open it and explore. I just need to be the one to let them know that it's safe to do so

teachings.name: Manifestor Wall Protection
teachings.insight: The energy itself is very fragile, but it has a strong wall to protect. It's like a turtle that constantly carries that, but inside, it's a very fragile and vulnerable.

teachings.name: Manifester Anger and Collective Impact
teachings.insight: If you're not aware of that anger and rage, it goes out and gets put on to other people, situations, experiences. Our aura is polarizing, and we are genuinely the initiators of the entire group. Manifestors almost, we're the ones that set the tone. We set the standard. If we're irresponsible with our informing, if we're irresponsible and overriding our authority, we're the ones that are setting basically the collective to feel whatever anger.

response:
Yeah so this is something that's really important to understand because a lot of manifestors walk around thinking something is wrong with them. Like why do people keep pulling away from me? Why does it feel like I'm constantly being met with resistance?

And here's the thing — it's not you doing anything wrong. Your aura is actually working overtime to protect you. You know, manifestors have historically always been under pressure. People trying to control us, manage us, figure us out. And because of that, the aura got thick. Dense. Like a wall.

But here's what I love to say — think of a turtle. Right? On the outside it looks strong, almost impenetrable. But inside? It's actually really fragile and vulnerable. That's you, babe. That's the manifestor energy.

And the thing is, people can't read you. Not because you're blocking them out intentionally — it's just that the aura is so thick they genuinely can't see what's going on in there. So they feel uncertain, and uncertainty makes people pull back.

I think of it like a closed book. I'm not an open book. But I'm absolutely happy for people to open it and explore — I just need to be the one to let them know it's safe to do so.

That's the key. You're not broken. You just have to give permission. That changes everything.

question: I'm a Manifestor and I keep getting told I'm too intense. Why does this keep happening?
cypher_query: MATCH (r:RayJaiTeaching) WHERE r.related_hd_concept CONTAINS "Manifestor" AND (r.insight CONTAINS "intense" OR r.context CONTAINS "intensity" OR r.insight CONTAINS "aggression" OR r.context CONTAINS "aggression") RETURN r.name, r.insight, r.context, r.related_hd_concept LIMIT 20

teachings.name: Teaching: Open does not mean absent
teachings.insight: Having an open or undefined center doesn't mean you don't have it. It's there — just like the astrological belt, we all have all of the planets within us. The nuance is in how it's activated.

teachings.name: Teaching: Borrowed and amplified energy
teachings.insight: With open centers you borrow energy from your environment — from friends, family, whoever is in your field — and you amplify it. It's not yours to keep, but it moves through you.

teachings.name: Teaching: HD is a synthesis
teachings.insight: Human Design is a synthesis of all these other modalities. It's presented in a polarizing way — not reader friendly, not user friendly, especially for someone who prefers to self-explore.

teachings.name: Teaching: MG Triple Threat
teachings.insight: Manifesting Generators are triple threats. You have the manifestor's throat to initiate and inform, the generator's sacral to complete, and the solar plexus motor connecting them. Manifestors can initiate but can't sustain. Generators can sustain but can't initiate. MGs have both.

teachings.name: Teaching: MG pivot permission
teachings.insight: As a Manifesting Generator it is okay to not finish everything. You can start 10 things and finish five. Not every initiation you bring forward is yours to complete — sometimes the initiation is done from your end for someone else to complete.

teachings.name: Teaching: Channel creates chemistry
teachings.insight: When two people each have one gate of a channel, they complete it together — that creation of the channel is where the chemistry or dynamics between people actually occur. It's also where attraction and repulsion come from.

teachings.name: divided_commitment_challenge
teachings.insight: you know, raise one of those one foot in, one foot out, guys

teachings.name: Digitizing Meetups Opportunity
teachings.insight: is there an opportunity for us to digitize this

teachings.name: HD as synthesis and deconditioning tool
teachings.insight: I think human design is a synthesis of, I would say, various schools of thought, various modalities around how to live your life... we come into this world without conditioning. And this is a system. This is a way of thinking. This is a school of thought that helps you to live your life, preconditioning, or maybe in a better way to re meet the individual that you were or that you are before anybody else told you who to be.

teachings.name: Initial Rejection Then Curiosity
teachings.insight: human design was first introduced to me in 2018 and my initial reaction towards it, when I was first introduced, I completely rejected it. I thought that it was bullshit. And I think what happened was during covid, were two things that happened to people in covid. One, you either lost your shit because you were trying to find external distractions, or to a lot of us, we chose to go inward

teachings.name: Body Recognition of Resonance
teachings.insight: my body is responding even just to me listening to these manifestos on YouTube. I could feel circuitry frequencies and movements in my body, and these were feelings that I would only recognize that I would experience when I was either in some sort of deep meditation, when I would maybe be participating in some sort of plant medicine ceremony

teachings.name: Textbook vs Personalized Reading
teachings.insight: I was extremely disappointed because basically this individual read everything to me that I had already known, and it was so textbook. It lacked any interpretation, tailored or curated in part

teachings.name: Engagement Required for Understanding
teachings.insight: there must be a conscious, or even maybe a subconscious engagement with the tool, with the school, with the way of thinking for you to really start to understand what it's like

teachings.name: Channel 26-44 as Surrender
teachings.insight: the 2644 not only is it a line of like the salesman, but it's also this. It's called a channel of surrender for a reason, and it's basically you surrender to to what is happening around you, because there's this inner knowing that, okay, there's something there. I might not see it. I might not fully grasp what it looks like in its entirety, or it hasn't fully crystallized, but there's something there, and I know it

teachings.name: Never Force Human Design
teachings.insight: I never force it, because that's not, it's not a use of my energy in the right way, nor is it a good use of theirs

teachings.name: Instinctive downloads during readings
teachings.insight: The book is saying this, but I think what it's really wanting to let you know is this

teachings.name: Network-based synchronicity
teachings.insight: through my network, which is how I operate

teachings.name: HD reception through feeling
teachings.insight: Meeting the Human Design modality is not about you having to understand everything at a scholastic level or an academic level. Some of this is going to hit and you're just going to feel it in your body, and some of it will fly, and that's okay, because you receive what you need to receive in that moment.

teachings.name: Human Design as business differentiator
teachings.insight: If there's an extra something that you can provide to your client that doesn't have to be product associated all the time, then you really can capture some lifetime value with these guys, because you've gone into a whole nother sphere of their psyche that they didn't anticipate you would

teachings.name: The power of surprise in capturing hearts
teachings.insight: That level of surprise, in my opinion, I think, is what captures the hearts of people

response:
Oh, that's such a real experience for Manifestors. And honestly? I want you to sit with this for a second — because "too intense" is one of the most common things Manifestors hear, and it usually comes from people who just aren't built the way you are.

Here's what I think is actually happening. Manifestors have that direct line to the throat. You initiate. You move energy in a way that other types literally don't have access to in the same way. So when you show up, people feel it. And for a lot of people, that feeling is unfamiliar, and unfamiliar can get misread as intense.

The question I'd want to explore with you is — how does that land for you when someone says it? Because there's a difference between you genuinely being out of alignment and someone just not being ready for your frequency.

Now I will say — the one thing that tends to soften that experience for Manifestors is informing. Not asking permission, but letting people know what's coming before you move. It changes the dynamic completely. People feel included rather than steamrolled.

But I want to ask you — does this happen everywhere, or in specific environments? Because that context matters a lot in how we decode what's actually going on here. How does this feel for you when we sit with it?
